description: A shell script designed to test git rebase scenarios, including handling of multi-line commit messages, diff in commit messages, and empty commit messages. It sets up a git repository, creates various commits with different message formats, and runs rebase commands to verify their behavior.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the specified commands.

methods.name: test_expect_success 'rebase commit with multi-line subject'
methods.description: Verifies rebase operation correctly handles commits with multi-line subjects.

methods.name: test_expect_success 'rebase commit with diff in message'
methods.description: Verifies rebase operation correctly handles commits with diff content in messages.

methods.name: test_expect_success 'rebase -m commit with empty message'
methods.description: Tests rebase with -m option on commits with empty messages.

methods.name: test_expect_success 'rebase -i commit with empty message'
methods.description: Tests interactive rebase with an empty commit message and reword operation.
